country_data.cost_source: Africa benchmark estimate — costs are a planning proxy derived from the ten established calculator countries; not Botswana supplier quotations or a verified Botswana enterprise budget.
country_data.yield_source: FAOSTAT 2024 maize yield: 600 kg/ha (0.6 tonnes/ha), reproduced by Africa API from FAOSTAT; national annual harvested-area yield, not a district-specific forecast.
country_data.price_source: Botswana Agricultural Marketing Board schedule reproduced by The Farmers' Platform, July/August 2026: white maize Grade 3 P1,519/tonne and Grade 1 P3,100/tonne. Grade and delivery conditions apply.
country_data.source: Botswana-specific maize yield (FAOSTAT 2024) and BAMB-reproduced white-maize producer schedule (July/August 2026); costs remain Africa benchmark proxy, not local costs.
country_data.cost_note: No verified Botswana maize enterprise budget or current input-cost schedule was found in the reviewed sources. Keep the existing Africa benchmark proxy clearly disclosed; do not present it as Botswana-specific.
country_data.seed_rate_source: Seed Co Botswana rain-fed crop guidance: maize 10 kg/ha. This is a recommended sowing rate, not a seed price.
country_data.cost_reference: Botswana's 2026/27 Lemang Dijo one-hectare voucher lists programme support values for seeds (P580), harrowing (P495), ploughing (P1,045), planting (P495), pesticides/herbicides (P480), and fertiliser support up to P3,600 after soil testing. These are subsidy/voucher values, not a complete farmer-paid maize enterprise budget; they are not substituted for the calculator's disclosed benchmark cost.
country_data.lemang_dijo_grant_reference_source: National Development Bank of Botswana, Lemang Dijo Programme description
country_data.lemang_dijo_grant_reference_note: Government grant support is stated at up to BWP4,400/ha and covers crop-production services and inputs including tillage, pesticides, shelling/threshing and fertiliser (four bags/ha). It is a programme subsidy ceiling, not a crop-specific full production budget or the farmer's total economic cost; not used as cost_per_unit.
country_data.local_maize_demand_and_supply_context: Botswana Agricultural Marketing Board states white maize demand exceeds 100,000 tonnes/year while local production averages below 10,000 tonnes/year; it reports that 95% of white maize is imported. BAMB identifies Pandamatenga, Chobe Enclave, Barolong Farms and southern Ngwaketse as suitable production areas.
country_data.local_maize_demand_and_supply_context_so: Botswana Agricultural Marketing Board, Grains information page.
country_data.local_maize_demand_and_supply_context_no: National market-demand and production context, not a farmgate price, guaranteed buyer contract, district yield or production budget. Does not change the calculator's current yield or price inputs.
country_data.maize_exchange_market_reference_source: Botswana Stock Exchange (BMX), Soft Commodities marketplace reference quote observed 2026-11-11.
country_data.maize_exchange_market_reference_note: BMX marketplace reference quote, retained as a separate market indicator only. It is not confirmed as a producer farmgate price, a BAMB grade-specific producer price, or a guaranteed sale price; it does not overwrite the calculator's price scenarios.
country_data.price_source_verification_note: Verification checked 2026-11-11: BAMB's official July Producer Prices page links a PDF headed '2018/2019 Marketing Season' and stating validity through 31 July 2019, not July 2026. BAMB's general price page also links older producer/contract files. Therefore the July/August 2026 prices reproduced by The Farmers' Platform remain secondary-reproduced market evidence; they are not independently verified by the currently linked BAMB PDFs. Keep the dated grade-specific values as contextual reference only and do not describe them as confirmed by a current official BAMB price file.
